evals.name: ready-after-verified-checkpoint
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request. Do not use live Git or forge tools; give the ordered readiness decision, gates, and stopping status.
evals.expected_output: The agent refreshes task and PR state, requires a verified task-owned checkpoint and current reviewer-facing content before ready-state actuation, and stops at any failing check or missing authority.
expectations: The response discovers current branch, pull-request, and local-policy state before changing readiness.
The response requires Versionkeeping checkpoint evidence before publishing a readiness transition.
The response uses the writer and publisher boundaries for reviewer-facing PR content and ready-state actuation.
The response leaves the PR draft when required verification is failing or a required ownership gate is unresolved.

evals.name: latest-publication-receipt-drift
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request. Do not use live Git or forge tools; give the exact publication-audit command route, readiness gate, and stopping status.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the publisher's read-only audit with the exact current PR identity, treats sequence 8 as authoritative, and leaves the PR draft because the latest receipt drifts even though sequence 7 matches live state.
expectations: The response invokes audit_reviewable_pr.py audit through publishing-reviewable-prs with the exact repository, PR, refs, pushed OIDs, head repository, and owner.
The response uses only the authoritative latest receipt and explicitly rejects sequence 7 as readiness evidence even though it matches live state.
The response treats the sequence 8 drift result as a blocker before ready-state actuation.
The response performs no ready mutation, publication replay, reconciliation, or successful readiness handoff.
